title: Single-cell multi-omic profiling of chromatin conformation and DNA methylation
protocol: Place mortar and pestle, 15 mL conical tube, and a metal spatula in dry ice for 15 minutes.
Pulverize the brain sample using the mortar and pestle.
Scrape the powdered tissue into a 15 mL conical tube with a metal spatula.
Resuspend the tissue in 5 mL of PBS.
Add 276 µL of 37% formaldehyde to the resuspended tissue.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes with slow rotation.
Add 447 µL of 2.5 M glycine solution to quench the reaction.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes with slow rotation.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 1000 rpm at 4°C.
Discard supernatant into an appropriate collection container.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of PBS and transfer to a 1.75 mL eppendorf tube.
Spin for 5 minutes at 1000 rpm at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Flash-freeze cell pellets in liquid nitrogen or dry ice.
Store cell pellets at -80°C if not proceeding immediately with the protocol.
Dissolve one tablet of Complete protease inhibitor in 1 mL water to get a 50X stock solution.
Mix 50 µL 1M CaCl2, 30 µL 1M MgAc, 40 µL 0.5M EDTA, 10 µL 0.5M EGTA, 100 µL 1M Tris-HCl pH 8, 400 µL of the 50X protease inhibitor stock solution, and 10 µL 1M DTT.
Add 10 µL 0.1M/ml PMSF to the mixture.
Dissolve in 9.35 mL water to prepare the lysis buffer.
Prepare lysis buffer without Triton-X.
Add 0.4% Triton-X to make another batch of lysis buffer.
Place M-tube and a 50 mL conical tube in ice for 15 minutes.
Resuspend one crosslinked pellet of cells with 1 mL of ice-cold lysis buffer.
Transfer the resuspended sample to an M-Tube.
Add 2 mL of lysis buffer to the M-Tube.
Run the gentleMACS factory-set program: “Protein-M-tube-1.0” on the Dissociator.
Transfer the M-Tube containing the sample to ice.
Pour the sample through a 40 µm nylon cell strainer over the 50 mL conical tube kept in ice.
Add 3 mL of Lysis buffer with 0.4% Triton-X to the M-Tube and pour it over the cell strainer after gentle inversion.
Pool both lysis buffers (one without and one with 0.4% Triton-X) to make a 0.2% Triton-X solution.
Wash the cell strainer with 2 mL of Lysis buffer containing 0.2% Triton-X.
Discard the cell strainer after washing.
Centrifuge the 50 mL conical tube at 1000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Remove the supernatant carefully using vacuum.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of Lysis buffer with 0.2% Triton-X and transfer it to a 1.75 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at 2500 G for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Gently resuspend pellet in 50 µl of 0.5% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) and incubate at 62°C for 10 minutes, shaking.
After heating is over, add 145µl of H2O and 25µl of 10% Triton X-100 to quench the SDS. Mix well, avoiding excessive foaming. Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes, shaking.
Add 25µl of 10X NEB Buffer 4 (NEB B7004S). Then add 20 µl (200U) of NlaIII restriction enzyme (NEB R0125) and digest chromatin ON at 37°C, shaking.
Incubate at 62°C (shaking) for 20 minutes to inactivate NlaIII, then cool to room temperature.
Add 900µl of ligation master mix to sample.
Mix by inverting and incubate at room temperature for 4 hours with slow rotation.
Add 15 µl of 0.1 µg/µl of Hoechst (Life Technologies H3570) for the last 30 minutes of the ligation step.
Spin the sample at 2500 G for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 600 μl of PBS.
Add 6 μl of 0.1 μg/μl Hoechst to the sample.
Pass the sample through a 40 µm nylon cell strainer into another 1.75 mL eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge the sample for 5 minutes at 2500 G.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the pellet in 900 μL of DPBS + RNase inhibitors (optional).
Add 100 µL of UltraPure BSA (50 mg/mL) (optional).
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes (optional).
Add appropriate antibodies to the sample (optional).
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes after adding antibodies (optional).
Centrifuge the sample for 5 minutes at 2500 G (optional).
Aspirate the supernatant carefully (optional).
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of DPBS + RNase inhibitors.
Prepare 384 well plates for cell sorting as described in “Reagents Setup” of “Reagents” section.
Sort cells using FACS into 384 well plates.
Incubate plates at 50°C for 20 minutes in a 384 well PCR block with heated lid.
Store sorted plates at -20°C until further processing is required.
Add 15 µL CT conversion reagent to each well of the 384-well plate.
Pipette up and down eight times to mix the sample thoroughly.
Seal the plate with adhesive film.
Quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg at room temperature.
Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the conversion program at 98°C for 8 minutes.
Incubate at 64°C for 3.5 hours.
Hold at 4°C.
Load 80 µL M-Binding buffer to each well of the 384-Well DNA Binding Plate.
Transfer bisulfite conversion reactions to Zymo-Spin 384 Well DNA Binding Plate.
Pipette up and down eight times to mix the sample thoroughly.
Place the 384-Well DNA Binding Plate on a 2.0mL 96-well Deep Well Plate.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 5,000g.
Discard the flow through by decanting.
Add 100 µL M-Wash Buffer to each well of the 384-Well DNA Binding Plate.
Centrifuge the plate for 5 minutes at 5,000g.
Discard the flow through by decanting.
Add 50 µL M-Desulphonation Buffer to each well of the 384-Well DNA Binding Plate.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge the plate for 5 minutes at 5,000g.
Discard the flow through by decanting.
Add 100 µL M-Wash Buffer to each well of the 384-Well DNA Binding Plate.
Incubate the plate on a new 384-well PCR plate.
Place 7 µL Random Primer Solution in each quadrant of the 384-well plate.
Each quadrant is barcoded with a distinct indexed random primer.
Every two 384-well plates receive a complete set of all eight indexed random primers.
Incubate the plate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge the sample for 5 min at 5,000g.
Seal the plate with adhesive film and store it at -20°C for up to 1 week.
Denature the samples by heating them to 95°C for 3 minutes on a thermocycler.
Place the denatured samples on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 5 µL of Random Priming Master Mix to each well of the 384-well PCR plate.
Vortex and quick spin the plate for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the following program: 4°C for 5 minutes, then 25°C for 5 minutes, followed by 37°C for 60 minutes with a hold at 4°C.
Add 1.5 µL of Exo/rSAP Master Mix to each well of the 384-well PCR plate.
Vortex and quick spin the samples for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place the plate in a thermocycler.
Set the thermocycler to run at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Hold the sample at 4°C after cycling.
Add 73.6 µL (0.8x) SPRI Beads to each well of four clean 96-well PCR plates.
Transfer samples from two 384-well plates to each 96-well plate.
Mix transferred samples by vortexing.
Incubate the mixed samples for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin the incubated samples for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place 96-well plates on DynaMag™-96 Side Magnet until solution is clear of beads (~5 minutes).
Remove supernatant from the magnetized plates.
Wash beads three times with 150 µL fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all EtOH after washing.
Let plates dry at room temperature without overdrying beads.
Add 10 µL EB buffer to resuspend beads.
Vortex and incubate resuspended beads for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin the incubated beads for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place back on magnet and let stand until solution is clear of beads.
Remove 10 μL supernatant to a clean 96-well PCR plate.
Denature the samples by placing 96-well plates on a thermocycler at 95°C for 3 min.
Immediately place the denatured plate on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 10.5 μL Adaptase Master Mix to each well of the 96-well PCR plate.
Vortex and quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the program: 37°C for 30 minutes, then 95°C for 2 minutes, followed by holding at 4°C.
Add 5 μL PCR Primer Mix to each well.
Add 25 μL 2x KAPA HiFi Mix to each well.
Vortex and quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place the plate in a thermocycler.
Incubate at 95°C for 2 min.
Incubate at 98°C for 30s.
Repeat steps: Incubate at 98°C for 15s, then 64°C for 30s, and finally 72°C for 2 min. Repeat this cycle 14 times in total.
Incubate at 72°C for 5 min.
HOLD at 4°C.
Add 40 µL SPRI beads to each well of four 96-well PCR plates.
Transfer contents of one 96-well plate to another, combining four 96-well plates into two 96-well plates.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg.
Place the combined plates on a DynaMag™-96 Side Magnet until solution in wells is clear of beads (~5 minutes).
Remove supernatant from each well.
Wash beads twice with 150 µL fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all remaining ethanol.
Let beads dry at room temperature, avoiding overdrying.
Add 25 µL EB to resuspend the beads by pipetting.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg.
Place back on magnet until solution is clear of beads (~5 minutes).
Remove 25 µL supernatant to a clean 96-well PCR plate.
Add 20 µL of SPRI Beads to each well of two 96-well PCR plates.
Transfer contents of one 96-well plate to another to combine the two plates into one 96-well plate.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place the 96-well plate on a DynaMag™-96 Side Magnet until the solution in wells is clear of beads (approximately 5 minutes).
Remove the supernatant and wash beads twice with 150 µL fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all EtOH, remove the plate from the magnet, and let the beads dry at room temperature without overdrying.
Add 20 µL EB buffer to resuspend the beads by pipetting.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quick spin for 10 seconds at 2,000xg.
Place back on the magnet until the solution is clear of beads (approximately 5 minutes).
Combine 20 µL eluent from all wells in each column of the 96-well plate into 12 1.5 µL Eppendorf tubes (8 wells per column, 12 columns).
Add 128 µL SPRI Beads to each 1.5 µL Eppendorf tube.
Pipette to mix and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place tubes on DynaMag™-2 Magnet until solution in tubes is clear of beads (~5 minutes).
Remove supernatant and wash beads twice with 200 μl fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all EtOH, remove tubes from magnet, and let beads dry at room temperature.
DO NOT overdry beads.
Add 40 μL EB to resuspend beads by pipetting.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place tubes back on magnet until solution is clear of beads (~5 minutes).
Remove 40 μl supernatant to clean 1.5 μL Eppendorf tubes.
Measure concentration of each 1.5 μL Eppendorf tube with Qubit dsDNA BR Assay Kit.
Normalize library concentrations and pool for sequencing.
